items.title: Lunar horizon illustration
items.generate: Landscape illustration for a restrained lunar documentary, designed to survive a tall center crop. Distinctly hand-painted editorial gouache on textured paper, not a historical photo or a photoreal rendering. Stack the two focal elements on the vertical centerline: a small blue Earth centered at 50% width and 28% height, and one understated astronaut bootprint directly below it at 50% width and 68% height. Keep their entire silhouettes inside the central 25% of the image width; the left and right sides are expendable negative space. A low, quiet ridge crosses the image between Earth and the bootprint; silvery powdered regolith in the foreground, ink-black sky above. Charcoal and pale silver with a subtle cold blue accent, late raking sunlight from the left. Rich soil texture, quiet atmosphere. No people, machines, flags, lettering or logos.
